name: @agensfield/scriba
description: Fast local usage tracking for Claude Code and Codex.

scripts.build: node scripts/clean-dist.mjs && bun build src/cli.ts --target node --format esm --external libsql --outfile dist/cli.js --minify && bun build src/index.ts --target node --format esm --external libsql --outfile dist/index.js --minify && tsc -p tsconfig.json --outDir dist && node scripts/fix-build.mjs
scripts.gate: bun run lint && bun run typecheck && bun run test
